name: @openharnes/harnes
description: Harnes is the open coding agent.

scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run pack:release && npm run sync:docs
scripts.pack:release: mkdir -p public/releases && rm -f public/releases/*.tgz && npm pack --pack-destination public/releases && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const dir='public/releases';const tgz=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.tgz')&&f!=='harnes-latest.tgz').sort().pop();if(!tgz)process.exit(1);fs.copyFileSync(path.join(dir,tgz),path.join(dir,'harnes-latest.tgz'));console.log('packed',tgz,'-> harnes-latest.tgz');"
scripts.sync:docs: mkdir -p public/docs && cp docs/*.md public/docs/ && rm -f public/docs/openhost.md public/docs/*.html.bak
scripts.test: tsx --test src/positioning.test.ts src/config.test.ts src/loop.test.ts src/models/catalog.test.ts src/session.test.ts

author: OpenHarnes
